title: gossypium hirsutum var. mexicanum
intro: Gossypium hirsutum var. mexicanum, commonly known as Mexican cotton, is a variety of cotton plant that belongs to the genus Gossypium. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe and calm the skin, making it effective in treating irritations, wounds, and skin conditions such as eczema. The therapeutic actions of Mexican cotton include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its healing and soothing effects. The bioactive constituents of Mexican cotton include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
